أرتئي (form VIII)
# أَرْتَئِي (ʔartaʔī) /ʔar.ta.ʔiː/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
# أَرْتَئِيَ (ʔartaʔiya) /ʔar.ta.ʔi.ja/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
